reviews.title: Terrible app functionality
reviews.body: Needs a lot of work

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.body: Apps are meant to make navigating a lot simpler. I downloaded it after continuously using the BCBS website and wanting to have something more handy. This app can probably get you to one or to pages/screens before you have to close the app because you can’t go back ‘home.’ The app give you an initial instruction screen with menu buttons ‘before wondering off’ but once you click away front that screen, those buttons are gone, hence the reason why you can’t go back ‘home.’

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.body: This app is actually the worst designed app I have ever seen. It is literally impossible to navigate and use.

reviews.title: Yep, still haven’t made improvements
reviews.body: App is still junk and doesn’t work 100% of the time. They clearly don’t want to give out rewards and don’t care to fix anything. Garbage app. Probably the worst app experience I have ever had.

reviews.title: Lags all the time
reviews.body: Terrible app! Seriously how can nobody fix this app after so many complaints.

reviews.title: Fix your app.
reviews.body: You don’t have a back feature. This app is borderline unusable.

reviews.title: Literally Unusable
reviews.body: The app won’t accept my password even after resetting it.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.body: Downloaded this for my fitness program benefits and the app is literally unusable. The navigation pane disappears after you navigate to something. No way to go back to the Home Screen. Guess I just have to keep showing a screen shot of my fitness program id card. The fact there is zero Apple wallet integration for the id card is crazy as well. For how much blue cross blue shield members are paying this app could be way better.

reviews.title: Terribly useless app
reviews.body: Every time you start the app, it’s like if you were starting it for the first time, it has to connect to its website to authenticate my username and password and this weird Gray screen is always popping up, telling me what the keys do which don’t even show up on the app

reviews.title: Basically inoperable
reviews.body: How is this app so bad? It doesn’t have any way to navigate. You use to basically close the app anytime you want to go back home or anywhere really. The app itself doesn’t do anything but display information like logs of check ins to gyms. I’m surprised such bad app is associated with the company.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.body: This is the worst app I’ve ever used.

reviews.title: It doesn’t work at all
reviews.body: I spent hours trying to figure out how to log into the app, nothing worked.

reviews.title: Broken navigation & Experience
reviews.body: Wherever you open the app and log in it shows nav bar tips, but there is no nav bar! It’s completely gone. There isn’t a consistent way to go back to the home menu so the app needs to close, but every time you open the app it requires you to sign in again. Way too time consuming for check ins.

reviews.title: FRAUD, DON’T DO IT
reviews.body: This is fraud. Buyer beware. They refused to refund my money after billing me for a year after membership was cancelled. They said I did not call to cancel but I know I did. They will play games and rephrase written correspondence over the phone to make it sound like it says something it doesn’t.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.body: This app is now difficult to use. You can’t find any of the navigation controls. It is slow to respond. Can’t really use it

reviews.title: Barcode is scannable
reviews.body: They changed the barcode to be able to scan at the gym and it is not scannable whatsoever. I’ve emailed I’ve called and they don’t do anything about it.

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.body: Why is it so hard to use this app and website. Get better developers please. I can’t even book a class thru a studio. So might as well not even market that as a perk

reviews.title: Worst app ever written
reviews.body: A vibe coding teenager could make a more functional app. Buttons straight up do not work when pressed!

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.body: App is unresponsive, not sure why they even went through the trouble of building this.  Do better

reviews.title: Garbage App
reviews.body: Really, my kid could build a more reliable app. It’s glitchy and provides very little value. Just accessing your member card requires multiple attempts, closes, etc.

reviews.title: What are we doing here
reviews.body: The experience is abysmal. Pretty much is a website and an outdated one at that. Pages zoom and the like and support is sparse.

reviews.title: App Crashes a lot
reviews.body: Intermittently app crashes and won’t let me log in.  Deleted app, reloaded, turned off WiFi, same issue.

reviews.title: Error message
reviews.body: There’s a consistent error message when trying to update billing info. It’s been days…

reviews.title: Worst company
reviews.body: Terrible experience. Takes your money event after you cancel membership and refuses to reimburse you.

reviews.title: Rip Off
reviews.body:
$19 for base membership when the gym’s base membership is $10…

BCBS is literally charging us MORE.
Where is the discount?

reviews.title: Can't log in
reviews.body: New to bcbs, got an email about the program. Have tried all day to log in and it asks for my email address even though my login wasn't my email. When I try to reset my password it doesn't send the email. The desktop website wasn't working today either, just a blank screen, and sometimes would come up as a black screen with code and script. Useless.

reviews.title: Hasn’t worked in 2 years
reviews.body: I have been a member of the fitness program for a few years now. Changed the insurance one time to a higher deductible same BCBS insurance. Won’t allow access. Program still works. Changed back to original program still doesn’t work. It’s been over 2 years now and I still have to call the phone number to find a gym near me instead of just using the app. The app is complete garbage.

reviews.title: Having problems signing into my app
reviews.body: I tried to sign back into my app we could not find

reviews.title: Great program, useless app
reviews.body: “Something went wrong while trying to log in”. Every. Single. Time. This app is utterly useless.

reviews.title: App Will Not Login
reviews.body: App is terrible. You need to log in every time you open the app and after a couple weeks, the app was not able to log in at all. I can log in on the computer but I cannot check in to the gyms that I go to. Every time I log in on the app, I get an error message saying that something has gone wrong. I’ve tried redownloading it but it still fails to log in.

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.body: At first, there were no issues and everything worked just fine. However, the past couple of weeks, it wouldn’t allow me to login, and therefore, I’m unable to use the check in feature. I have no issues logging into the website but there isn’t a check in feature or at least I couldn’t find one. I’ve emailed twice to support and yet nothing.

reviews.title: Trash app
reviews.body: Worse app ever. Never works and constantly needs to log back in. Waste of time, company needs to do better.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.body: App does not work.

reviews.title: It’s okay, but needs serious fixing. Just go in to safari instead.
reviews.body: When I first got the app and used the benefits for it, it was fine for two days. The only gym I’ve gone so far is Planet Fitness. Another two days without using the app (because life decided to keep me more busy) I was planning on heading LA fitness that’s closer to home and check if they approve this. I tried to log in countless of times of this app and unfortunately it’s was getting useless. The only thing I can do is to log in from Safari- it’s pretty much similar what the app had. Hey, at least it work and as long as it works. That’s my honest opinion. Please have this app fixed.

reviews.title: Can’t log in to the app
reviews.body: Put my login information and just keeps giving me an error that something went wrong

reviews.title: Not functional
reviews.body: Can’t log into the app although I can access on a desktop fine.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.body: Can’t login to app and website is almost useless

reviews.title: Terrible by design
reviews.body: It seems like the app and the website was designed intentionally to discourage using the benefits. False advertisement at its best. You need to login every single time, and it redirects you to website portal. You can’t login in the app. My saved username and password doesn’t work anymore and I had to go to BCBS website, find fitness program link which was buried under useless information and articles, go to well on target website, enroll from beginning to retrieve my password. It seems like they deactivated all the username and password in the app without informing the users, and created this perplexing maze, so they don’t have to migrate information. Had a terrible embarrassing experience at the gym front desk because of this stupidity.

reviews.title: Terrible App
reviews.body: App hardly ever works. Can’t login and their website is almost as bad.

reviews.title: Won’t even let me log in
reviews.body: I signed in on my laptop no problem. However the app is rejecting my password. I even went ahead and reset my password on my laptop and signed in again there no problem. The app? Still rejects it. If I want to track my nutrition and fitness, I need to sign into the app so it can connect to my other apps. But the app won’t even let me sign in

reviews.title: Fix it
reviews.body: The app literally does not work. If you finally get to a point where you find the class you want to book and you click book, a bug prevents it from going through. So this app is good for absolutely nothing.

reviews.title: Unstable
reviews.body: This app is terrible. Logging into it is primitive. Must use full credentials every time. Where is Face ID, or perhaps a pinnnumber? Once you are in, self check in is convenient, but only when it’s working. Never seems to be up to date keeping track of the weekly log ins. Apps is set to auto check in with location services on but doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work anymore
reviews.body: For years this worked properly. Could see my check ins and all. Can’t even log in anymore.

reviews.title: Never works completely useless
reviews.body: This app never works and calling customer service is just as useless and frustrating as using this app

reviews.title: Pure garbage
reviews.body: Worthless app. Glitchy, doesn’t allow you to check-in, and the sign in process breaks half the time. Y’all need to fire whoever is behind this hunk of useless software

reviews.title: Total Scam from BCBS
reviews.body: They don’t let you join any decent gym and make it impossible to login or cancel EVEN WHEN THIS ISNT MY INSURANCE ANYMORE

reviews.title: Painful login
reviews.body:
The app makes you manually log in every time you use it. The login page is also a pop up browser that a password manager won’t recognize, so that’s another level of inconvenience. This is so painful especially when every other app I own allows for Face ID or pin login. 

Otherwise as far as I can tell everything else on the app works fine.

reviews.title: Fixed Issues
reviews.body: After 1/25 update, was able to log in and everything looks good.

reviews.title: Login Issues Persist
reviews.body: Haven’t been able to log in despite numerous account PW resets.  Including changing all my information on my insurance side.  Can only log in via web portal. App currently is unusable. Literally because I can never use it unless I spend hours with customer service.

reviews.title: Pay first, no support
reviews.body:
I just wanted to see a list of gyms that would fall under the benefit. 

It was advertised through my employer as a gym reimbursement, but that was only the start of my disappointment. I had to go through several options and giving of personal information, and finally it seemed like I was getting somewhere. I want you Fitness Programs and it instead had list of packages for me to buy with very little information.

One said access to 3000 gyms and another 11k which means nothing to me. I could not go another step without paying and giving my credit card information which is ridiculous. Just more insurance company trickery.

There was no support number listed or email or chat help, but I guess that is by design. Most people do not have time for the built in rigmarole.
